# Hjørring Kirurgi

Hjørring Kirurgi is a surgical department in the Danish health system that has achieved a re-operation rate of 0% for surgical procedures, a performance metric that falls below the national quality development target of 8% [^src1]. This zero re-operation rate indicates that no patients required a second operation within 30 days of their primary surgical intervention during the reporting period.

The department's performance is documented as part of DANIBD's 2024 annual report, which tracks quality indicators for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) treatment across Denmark's regions and hospital departments. The re-operation indicator serves as a measure of surgical quality and safety—a lower re-operation rate typically reflects better surgical outcomes and patient care. Hjørring Kirurgi's zero rate represents an exceptionally strong result, positioning the department well in relation to the national benchmark [^src1].
